title: docs: add Retrieval Playbooks quickstart for tool-chaining and RAG templates
author: Maya Chen
description:
This PR introduces a new Quickstart guide and example pack called 'Retrieval Playbooks' focused on practical tool-chaining patterns with RAG templates and operator guidance for production apps. Motivation: many teams ask for concrete, copy-pasteable playbooks that combine retrieval, tool calling (external search/SQL/LLM tools), and suggested prompt scaffolds to reduce time-to-first-success. The goal is pragmatic: 1) show 3 opinionated playbooks (faq-bot, docs-assistant with SQL tool, and multi-tool orchestration), 2) ship runnable examples in Python and TypeScript that use Redwood SDK patterns (streaming + tool callbacks), and 3) add docs site navigation and a small diagram to surface recommended rollout and observability knobs.
What changed:
- docs/guides/retrieval-playbooks.md: new guide with conceptual sections, configuration snippets, rollout checklist, and a short troubleshooting matrix.
- examples/playbooks/python/tool_chaining_example.py: minimal runnable example showing retrieval -> LLM -> SQL-tool -> final synthesis with Redwood streaming hooks.
- examples/playbooks/ts/tool_chaining_example.ts: TypeScript equivalent using the Redwood SDK and tool-calling callback helpers.
- examples/playbooks/playbooks.json: metadata for the examples catalog used by the Docs site.
- assets/diagrams/tool-chain.svg: visual overview of the playbook flow.
- site/config/navigation.yml: adds the new guide to the sidebar under "Guides > Patterns".
- tests/examples/run_examples.sh: small e2e smoke runner to verify examples build and run in CI.
Backwards compatibility: none of the changes affect runtime code paths; docs-only and examples-only.
Checklist:
- [x] Draft docs and examples
- [x] Add diagrams and playbook metadata
- [x] CI smoke tests for examples
- [x] Reviews from Docs + SDK owners
- [x] Update site nav and publish config
Links: Linear ENG-4521 (playbook RFC), internal discussion thread: https://linear.company/ENG-4521.
Testing notes: the examples run against a local Redwood dev endpoint (mockable) and the CI script validates sample responses and ensures tool callbacks are invoked. This description is intentionally one continuous string and includes the context, changeset summary, and rollout checklist.
